scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd rust-js --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run patch:compiler
scripts.compile: bun run patch:compiler && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js build --package agent-cube-web
scripts.dev: bun run compile && bunx --bun vite web
scripts.build: bun run compile && bun run bundle
scripts.check: bun run patch:compiler && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js build --package agent-cube-web --check && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js clippy --package agent-cube-web -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --package agent-cube-web -- --check
